issues.issue: Did the RAD err by not analysing whether a hearing under s 110(6) IRPA was warranted after admitting the new affidavit?
issues.applicant_position: Once the affidavit was admitted, the RAD had to analyse a s 110(6) hearing; its silence on this was a fatal error.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants said they did not require a hearing and gave no submissions; RAD reasonably found no serious credibility issue.
issues.result_quote: I find that the RAD made a sufficiently significant error to render its decision unreasonable.

issues.issue: Other arguments against the RAD decision.
issues.result_quote: There is no need to examine the other arguments put forward by the applicants against the decision
